entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly help with that. Could I please get your name and order number?
Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF88602.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Sonic Pro cycling shoes. Is that what you're calling about?
Alright. So I can process this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They gave me blisters after one ride. I'm not going to wear them again.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to confirm, did you have a chance to properly position the cleats or adjust the straps?
They should just work. I just want a refund.
Of course. Let me just confirm the purchase date... It looks like they were delivered 9 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so that's no problem at all.
Fine. So how do I do it?

I have just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You certainly will. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Well, thank you for your call. Have a good rest of your day.
